trigger: Mo's truck stop at the Mustang exit (trader; q_mo_pump).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: MUSTANG TRUCK STOP — DIESEL $41 OR TRADE. A woman in Carhartts behind a counter of sandbags.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: Maureen Kessinger. Mo. I don't do credit, I don't do sob stories, and I don't do the Army.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: Compact taxes me on the way in. Army taxes me on the way out. Prices are what they are.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: ...You hear that from out here? Huh. Fix my transfer pump and you get standing credit. Fair?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Two hours on your back in diesel slush. New bearing from a dead Kenworth. It purrs.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: Well. Damn. You're on the list, mechanic. Good list. The only list I keep.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: Darlene says you helped her too. She's moving her rig here. Chicken and diesel. We'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: Jug's full. I checked. Don't make me regret that.

nodes.speaker: trader_mo
nodes.text: Drive safe. Nobody's coming if you don't.
